landing.hero.title: File your claim with Sam — face-to-face, anytime.
landing.hero.body: Sam is our AI claims advocate. Talk to Sam by video or chat. We'll verify your policy, gather the facts, look at the damage, and book a tow, rental, and adjuster — usually in under fifteen minutes.
landing.emergency_note: In an emergency, call 911. Sam is not a substitute for emergency services.
auth.signin.title: Sign in to file a claim
auth.signin.subtitle: No password needed — we'll email you a one-tap link.
auth.check_email.title: Check your email
auth.check_email.body: We sent a sign-in link. It expires in 10 minutes.
newClaim.title: Let's file your claim
newClaim.subtitle: Pick how you'd like to talk to Sam. You can switch modes any time.
newClaim.kind.title: What happened?
video.title: Talking to Sam
video.help: Sam may slow down or pause if you sound shaken. You can always say "I need a human" — Sam will route you to a supervisor.
chat.title: Chat with Sam
photos.title: Photos for claim
photos.subtitle: Take each photo using your camera. Sam will pick these up automatically once you're done.
photos.expiry_note: Links expire one hour after Sam sent them. If a link expires, ask Sam to send a new one.
summary.estimate.title: Estimate range
summary.booked.title: Booked services
summary.adjuster_note: An adjuster will reach out within 24–48 business hours. You'll get a text and email when they do.
